text:
maria_support: FYI — customer acme-inc reports their Console shows $150 trial credits but API billing/usage shows no credits applied and they received a charge. Account ID: acct_9X2bL. They attached a screenshot of the console credit balance and a billing charge notice.

devon_ops: Thanks, forwarding to billing infra. Do we have the redemption record for their promo code or trial grant? Could be a metadata mismatch between account and billing customer.

maria_support: I checked: Console shows "Trial credits: $150 (expires 2025-11-02)" under acct_9X2bL -> billing. But the billing invoice shows charges on billing_customer BC_1123 for usage on 2025-10-16. Customer says they always used the same API key.

sanjay_eng: Can you paste the API request example and any response headers? We need to confirm which billing_customer_id the requests were routed under.

maria_support: Customer provided curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-ACMEKEY" \ 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"..."}'
```
No error responses, just normal tokens. They attached a screenshot of the billing usage page showing the tokens consumed but remaining trial credits unchanged.

devon_ops: I pulled request logs for sk-live-ACMEKEY. Requests map to account_id=acct_9X2bL but billing_customer_id=BC_1123. Is acct_9X2bL linked to BC_1123 in our billing table?

sanjay_eng: Quick check: SELECT * FROM billing.customers WHERE account_id='acct_9X2bL'; returns billing_customer_id NULL and a legacy_customer_id BC_1123 in invoices table. Looks like during a migration the invoice rows used legacy_customer_id, but promo_redemptions are tied to account_id. The promo grant was applied to account_id, but our realtime billing pipeline credits by billing_customer_id. So credits never got associated to the invoice stream.

maria_support: Oof. Customer hit $24.32 charge yesterday. They want the credits applied retroactively and a refund for the charged amount.

devon_ops: Plan: 1) Create a one-time manual credit grant against BC_1123 for $150 to cover past and future usage until expiry. 2) Run a small backfill job to sync promo_redemptions -> billing. Also create a follow-up migration to set billing_customer_id for accounts with legacy invoices.

sanjay_eng: I can prepare the backfill script. Quick patch (pseudo-SQL): 
```
UPDATE billing.customers bc
SET billing_customer_id = invoices.legacy_customer_id
FROM (
  SELECT legacy_customer_id, account_id
  FROM billing.invoices
  WHERE account_id = 'acct_9X2bL' LIMIT 1
) invoices
WHERE bc.account_id = invoices.account_id AND bc.billing_customer_id IS NULL;
```
I'll instrument it and run on a small test subset first.

devon_ops: For immediate customer relief, I'll issue manual credit: create_credit(billing_customer_id=BC_1123, amount=15000, reason="trial backfill - acct_9X2bL"). Will also create an invoice adjustment for the $24.32.

billing_bot: Incident created: INC-22714 — Manual credit issued pending confirmation. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-22714

maria_support: I'll message the customer that we found a migration mismatch, we're applying credits and issuing an invoice adjustment, ETA first 24 hours. They asked whether this can happen to other customers.

sanjay_eng: I found ~18 accounts with similar pattern where invoices reference legacy_customer_id but billing.customers.billing_customer_id is NULL. I'll include them in the backfill but will gate on safety checks.

devon_ops: Next steps: (A) apply manual credit + invoice adjustment for acct_9X2bL (in progress) (B) run backfill on small batch and verify no double-crediting (C) deploy migration to ensure future promo_redemptions write both account_id and billing_customer_id.

maria_support: Customer updated: they appreciate the quick response, requested confirmation when credit shows on their account and when refund posts. I'll keep them updated.

sanjay_eng: After backfill, I'll add a unit test to redemption flow and an alert if promo_redemptions exist without matching billing_customer_id for >24h.

devon_ops: Marking thread for postmortem doc in #postmortems after resolution. Tagging @finance for audit.

maria_support: Thanks all. I'll update INC-22714 with the customer-facing message and close once they confirm refund/credit applied. :thumbsup:
